_comment: Stars/verdicts on a BINDING — one sound attached to one game event. Ids are `<eventId>#<sound>` (e.g. `player.water_enter#splash`, `ui.press#composer/ui_tick`). A rejected entry means UNBIND that sound from that event; the recording itself stays in the library and is never deleted (maintainer 2026-08-06). To retire a recording, reject it in feedback/sounds.json or feedback/composer.json instead. Consumed by the composer (games-audio) agent.
